DO NOT lengthen the body or legs, DO NOT narrow the face, DO NOT turn this into polished anime. Draw this main character with EXACTLY the simple identity-reference construction.
SCENE CONTINUITY: bright conservatory greenhouse, pale wooden window grids, soft distant blue lake and green hills, leafy climbers, pots of tiny white flowers and lavender, two honey-brown wicker chairs with cream cushions, stone floor and muted terracotta woven rug. Natural daylight, fresh greens and blue, cream paper, coral; neutral bright light without strong yellow tint. Not glossy, not smooth digital/anime shading. No detailed fine hair, no complex clothing folds.
LAYOUT: single complete 16:9 landscape scene; core faces, both hands and notebooks within y=20–75% so a later subtitle band at y=88–96% cannot hide them. Natural floor, rug, chair legs and plants extend to ALL bottom edges, no blank band. Exactly two people, natural sleeve-wrist-hand attachment, only two arms per person. No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, UI or collage. Sketches are only rough pencil marks.

Moment 2 / the concrete sticking point. A closer over-the-interviewer's-shoulder shot toward the protagonist. The interviewer is on the far RIGHT foreground seen from the side/back; only her brown loose bun, coral shoulder, and a small portion of her green notebook/yellow pencil need appear; her shoulder stays outside the protagonist and cream notebook silhouette and does not obstruct them. Protagonist sits at LEFT/CENTER and is larger in frame while retaining exactly the original round face/short limbs/chibi identity. The protagonist has OPENED the cream notebook, raises it to chest/upper-lap level with the left hand supporting the bottom outside edge, and points the right index finger to ONE visibly repeatedly erased and crossed-out unfinished portion of the rough sketch. The open page faces partly toward interviewer and camera. On this page show a very simple rough pencil sketch of two separated stepping-stone clusters with the connecting middle repeatedly rubbed out, smudged and redrawn; the gap remains unfinished. It is only a rough narrative metaphor for a stuck thought, NO complete bridge or solved model. The protagonist looks down at this exact unresolved patch, candid and mildly confused: sparse eyebrows slightly knitted, tiny open mouth. Face around 30–45% height and notebook/hands around 50–72%. Clear two distinct arms, fingertips on page, clean physical attachment, no third hand.
